items.title: Kalshi: Fed decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 19:06 UTC on September 24, the direct page displayed 65% for Hike 25bps, 35% for Fed maintains rate, and 2% for Hike >25bps; two outcomes were hidden.

items.title: Polymarket: Fed Decision in October?
items.claim: At pool access time 19:06 UTC on September 24, the direct page displayed 66% for a 25 bp increase and 34% for no change; its rules use the upper-bound target-range change and name the October FOMC statement as resolution source.

items.title: CME FedWatch
items.claim: CME describes FedWatch as probabilities implied by 30-Day Fed Funds futures, but the direct live October grid was unreadable in this check.

items.title: Federal Reserve FOMC meeting calendar
items.claim: The official calendar lists the October 27–28, 2026 FOMC meeting.
